title: RF / detector board (RF_HMC, RF_HF, RF_INJECTOR, DC_CORE) 184 x 44.5 - placement and scripted RF copper
note: W2 PCB-RF-1: every RF-domain ref placed, RF50 copper scripted and locked, first route run. Written by build/kicad/boards/RF/rf_layout.py (edit the layout there, then rerun it). PCB-RF-2 routes to DRC 0, adds the coupon tab and the fab set. Nothing here is a fabrication release; bench gates stay OPEN.

layers.source: contract stackup JLC04161H-7628, 4 layers, 1.6 mm (mechanical/generated/contract/boards.json stackup; build/15); RF50 geometry from pcb/generated/netclasses.json (L1 over L2, h 0.2104 mm)

plan.F.Cu: all parts, RF50 CPWG (scripted, locked), signals, GND pour (coplanar ground)
plan.In1.Cu: solid GND reference plane under RF50 (pre-route zone, a DSN plane)

rules_note: rules_file stays null (pcb/board_gen.py does not copy .kicad_dru files yet); the net classes RF50 0.36/0.20, DCTAP 0.20/0.30 (project rule, not IPC-verified), PWR1A 0.35/0.15 and the default 0.20/0.15 live in RF.kicad_pro, values from pcb/generated/netclasses.json. Project zone defaults (used by the board_gen pours): clearance 0.20 (= RF50 CPWG gap), minimum width 0.20, thermal gap 0.25, spokes 0.30. min_hole_to_hole 0.45 = JLC pad hole-to-hole floor (via to via 0.2); the ENC value 0.5 refused 0.6/0.3 vias at 0.15 mm clearance. min_resolved_spokes 1: a HMC7992 GND pin between two RF pins takes only its outward spoke (project choice, reviewed in PCB-RF-2).

fab_floor.min_hole_to_hole_note: 0.45 = pad hole-to-hole of different nets; via hole-to-hole is 0.2

height_zones.why: footprints carry no body heights; the enclosure height check belongs to the mechanical model (fit-report)

warning_checks.footprint_filters_mismatch: schematic-parity check; per-board PCBs are not linked to the multi-sheet schematic, so DRC runs without --schematic-parity and the source-pad audit replaces it
warning_checks.missing_tuning_profile: no length-tuned nets and no tuning profiles on this board
warning_checks.tuning_profile_track_geometries: no length-tuned nets and no tuning profiles on this board
warning_checks.generic_warning: KiCad's catch-all warning class; any instance is listed in report.json and reviewed
warning_checks.silk_over_copper: legend only: the fab clips legend over exposed copper; the vendored PEC11R outline (tools/make_footprints.py) crosses its own A/C/B pads
warning_checks.silk_overlap: legend only: overlapping legend items are cosmetic; every instance is listed in report.json

rf_copper_not_drawn.status: OPEN: pcb/board_gen.py has no via, plated-hole or rule-area primitive in pre_route (W2 PCB-RF-1 finding)
items: GND via fences 0.3/0.6 mm at <= 2.0 mm pitch along every RF50 line (netclasses.json RF50 fence_pitch_max_mm, fence_row_max_from_gap_mm)
HMC7992 EPAD via arrays (ADI land pattern) under U405/U406/U407; Freerouting fans each EPAD out to the In1.Cu plane with single vias only
GND stitching of the four GND layers outside the pad fan-outs
GND fence ring around each HMC section for an optional shield can (no can fitted, no MPN)
BOND-RF: plated M3 hole on CHASSIS at (92, 40.5); here H5 stays NPTH and PH407 is the CHASSIS land
DC_CORE SENSE nets pre-routed with a GND guard (Freerouting routes them in this revision)
RF_TAPER rule areas for the 0.25 mm HMC pin entries (check_boards rf50_taper names them)
keeping Freerouting off In1.Cu (layer type power or plane_as_obstacle; the board_gen command line fixes neither)
rf_copper_not_drawn.owner: board_gen.py owner (PCB-PIPE lineage) or INT; PCB-RF-2 draws them once the primitive exists

decisions.topic: Shield can over the HMC sections
decisions.choice: no can fitted in this revision; a GND fence ring per HMC section is reserved (rf_copper_not_drawn)
decisions.reason: STACK.md names an optional shield wall or lid; a ring costs only copper and invents no MPN (A-PCB-06 decision)

decisions.choice: breakaway tab of the RF panel, built in PCB-RF-2
decisions.reason: same lamination and etch as the board (A-PCB-06 decision)

decisions.choice: top edge (y 44.5), beside the U.FL ports, instead of the bottom edge [100,184]
decisions.reason: the 73251-1153 body reaches 9.5 mm beyond the board edge (footprint courtyard -14.29 to -4.76 mm local), while RF.r0 is 0.4 mm from rfbay.wall.bottom (mechanical/generated/fit-report.md); beyond the top edge the bay has 18.3 mm (bay inner height 62.7 from y 99.1; board top at enclosure y 143.5). The V4L SMA ends sit at board x 81.6 (arrangement b), so J410/J411 at x 65-123 keep the cables short. MODEL reasoning; MECH must model the SMA overhang (OPEN).

decisions.topic: Board ends that the graph lacks
decisions.choice: U.FL lands (KiCad 10.0.7 U.FL_Hirose_U.FL-R-SMT-1_Vertical, the land of GR-2 J423-J427) as pilot placeholders PH401-PH406, and a 2 mm pad PH407 for CHASSIS
decisions.reason: design/** is outside PCB-RF-1; the boundary audit reports them provisional until GR-4/SRC-2 add the refs

decisions.choice: bottom edge x 120-171, openings to the edge
decisions.reason: harness routes S03/S04 reach the RF bottom edge at board x 163.3 and 167.5 (mechanical/generated/harness-routes.json)

decisions.choice: x 132-176 in channel rows (UHF, LBAND, HF top to bottom) with the reference and reference-good blocks to the right
